E11 – FET Small-Signal Analysis I: g_m, r_d and Common-Source Amplifiers (T10, Week 8)

Why this matters in the exam: The Week 8 slides (Module 3, “FET Small-Signal Analysis”) and WS8 Q7–15 are the course’s whole treatment of FET ac analysis. Every question has the same three-step skeleton: find the DC Q-point, get (and ), then read , and off the ac equivalent circuit. The practice test only covered Weeks 1–5, so there is no FET past paper in your files. But the final is expected to weight FETs and Weeks 6–10. A CS-amplifier question chained onto a Week 7 bias calculation is a natural 8–12 mark question (WS8 Q13 and Q15 are exactly this shape). It is very learnable: it is the BJT workflow from E6 with in place of and , and with a gate that draws no current.

4. Traps that cost marks

  • Skipping the DC step. depends on . You cannot write unless (e.g. WS8 Q14). Show the Q-point line even when it is given.
  • Sign inside the bracket. uses both signs: , not 1.25. Only uses .
  • Wrong Shockley root. The self-bias and divider quadratics have two roots. Reject the one with (JFET) or (E-MOSFET). WS8 Q15’s spurious root is −0.75 V.
  • Using the JFET formula on an E-MOSFET. For WS8 Q15 use .
  • Treating an unbypassed as bypassed (or the reverse). Look for in the figure. With present, only affects DC.
  • Dropping the minus sign on or (as slide 40 does). The CS stage inverts.
  • Putting into . is looking back into the amplifier. only enters .
  • Unit slips: µS vs mS, MΩ in . Use mS × kΩ, which gives a dimensionless gain directly.

7. Add to your open-book reference sheet

FET SMALL-SIGNAL (Week 8)          ALWAYS: DC Q-point -> gm, rd -> ac circuit
gm0 = 2 IDSS/|VP|        gm = gm0(1 - VGSQ/VP) = gm0*sqrt(IDQ/IDSS)   (JFET, D-MOS)
E-MOS: gm = 2k(VGSQ - VGS(Th))     gm = gfs = yfs      rd = 1/gos = 1/yos
Model: G-S open | gm*Vgs (D->S) || rd | same model for JFET/D-MOS/E-MOS
Device only: Zo = rd, Av(FET) = -gm*rd
CS fixed / self-bias(Cs) / divider(Cs):  Zi = RG or R1||R2,  Zo = RD||rd,
                                         Av = -gm(RD||rd)  (~ -gm RD if rd >= 10RD)
CS unbypassed RS (rd ignored): Zi = RG, Zo ~ RD, Av = -gm RD/(1 + gm RS)
   with rd: Av = -gm RD/(1 + gm RS + (RD+RS)/rd)
Load/source: Av = -gm(rd||RD||RL); Avs = Zi/(Zi+Rsig) * Av; Zo excludes RL
DC reminders: fixed VGS=-VGG; self VGS=-ID RS; divider VGS=VG-ID RS;
   D-MOS with G,S at 0 V -> ID = IDSS, gm = gm0.  Pick root with VGS > VP (or > VGS(Th)).
   Saturation check: VDS > VGS - VP  (E-MOS: VDS > VGS - VGS(Th))
Design for gain: RD||rd = |Av|/gm -> RD = 1/(1/(RD||rd) - 1/rd); recheck VDS
Graphical gm: tangent slope at Q, or chord symmetric about Q (exact for parabola)
Link to BJT: 1/gm plays the role of re.  CS output 180 deg out of phase.
